add.title: Make the spoken 'tap to hear it' match what a tap does
add.why: The collapsed agent-update line says 'tap to hear it', but a tap only pauses or resumes what is already playing (read-aloud-b review, round 5, note 2).

add.title: Order every reply by relevance, not only held agent updates
add.why: 'The most relevant direct answer comes first' holds only for agent updates held while the cue is pending; two smart replies, or an update queued before the owner's line, still play in arrival order (read-aloud-b review, round 5, note 1).

add.title: Stop Recite filing a diagnostic on every sheet open
add.why: dictate-red-tests saw Recite file a diagnostic each time the sheet opens (dictation-v3 harvest, 2026-11-02).
